In Step 4, WebServing_Expert incorrectly treated Lauria’s own dissertation (“The Logic of the Liver”) as the referenced work and began searching for SAAM paintings quoting that title. The log shows this misinterpretation clearly and it redirected the entire search down the wrong path. No later step corrected this misunderstanding, making Step 4 the first mistake that led to the final failure.

This constitutes the first substantive misstep that drives the rest of the process off course. Subsequent steps build on this wrong assumption and never return to identify footnote 397, so the mistake was not corrected.
